entries.title: Arrival boundary excluded
entries.root_cause: The berth availability predicate excludes an arrival exactly at the opening time. Make the opening boundary inclusive.

entries.title: Departure boundary included
entries.root_cause: The berth availability predicate includes a departure exactly at the closing time. Make the closing boundary exclusive.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Another boundary assertion in the same suite fails, but the closing comparison must change rather than the opening comparison.

entries.title: Overnight interval rejected
entries.root_cause: Berth availability returns false for an arrival inside an overnight window. Correct availability handling for intervals that cross midnight.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A similar availability assertion fails for an interval crossing midnight; correcting the interval logic is separate from making the opening boundary inclusive.

entries.title: Unknown mooring class
entries.root_cause: DispatchBoard references MooringSlot in works.celandine.mooring.model, but the compiler cannot find that class in the package.
